name: aws-map-it-backend
comment: Amplify Gen 2 backend module marker. The backend CLI + CDK dependencies (@aws-amplify/backend, @aws-amplify/backend-cli, aws-cdk-lib, constructs) live in the ROOT package.json devDependencies, NOT here — Amplify Hosting runs `npm ci` against the ROOT package.json, so `ampx` must be installed from root for `ampx pipeline-deploy` to resolve. This file only marks amplify/ as an ES module.
